## Overview

Lifecycle of a dialog panel, mirrored on the panel as `data-state` for consumer CSS:
`opening` (mounted, enter styles) → `open` → `closing` (exit transition running, only with
`presence`) → `closed` (removed).

- **Kind:** Type alias
